title: Grateful Dead Live at Oxford Plains Speedway on 1988-07-02
lineage: Tascam DA20 Mark II -> Roland SRC-2 -> Mac Mini > Audacity 3.0 @ 44K -> WAV; Edited & Mastered in Audacity 2.0.6 by Joe Noel: wav > Flac 16/44; Checksum & tags created in xACT
source: Jeff Silberman Master FOB Recording: Neumann U89 spaced omnis -> Technics SV-100 -> PCM; John Ammons

ai_review.summary: Excellent low‑end‑rich recording that captures Phil’s thundering bass, delivering a great‑sounding show.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised for its deep low‑frequency detail and the clarity of the Neumann microphones, which bring out Phil Lesh’s thunderous bass line throughout the performance. Reviewers note the overall sound quality as outstanding, making this a must‑listen recording despite no specific song commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 5‑star review emphasizes superb recording fidelity and strong performance of Phil’s bass; limited data yields a confident but moderate rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Lots of low‑end information, Neumann microphones capture detailed instrument separation, especially pronounced bass response.

band_member_comments.Phil: Thundering bass captured vividly by the Neumann microphones.
